response.why: No legal blocks exist since Sheoldred lacks flying/reach against their two fliers; I take 3 unblockable damage but still hold a dominant board with Sheoldred plus a full grip, well ahead on card quality and life-drain potential.
response.plan: Keep Sheoldred back as a deathtouch blocker/threat; next turn add Preacher of the Schism or Enduring Curiosity and start pressuring with Sheoldred's card-draw life swing.
